name: Foreign Investor Permanent Residency (SUACE)

requirements.blocker_text: To obtain the Constancia de Inversionista Extranjero from the Vice-Ministry of Industry and Commerce (via the SUACE one-stop business window), the applicant must commit to investing a minimum of USD 70,000 in the Paraguayan economy AND create at least 5 professional/technical-level local jobs, both completed within a maximum of 24 months. (A widely-republished tier-3 summary claims the USD 70,000 can be spread over 10 years -- this build's tier-1 source directly contradicts that, stating a 24-month completion window for both the investment and the job-creation commitment; this dataset follows the tier-1 figure.) The Constancia then supports a Permanent Residency application at the Dirección Nacional de Migraciones (DNM), requiring apostilled/legalized birth and civil-status certificates, criminal background checks (home country, country of residence, INTERPOL, and Paraguayan police), a local police life-and-residence certificate, and a sworn constitutional-compliance declaration. The resulting Cedula is permanent but must be physically renewed every 10 years. Fees confirmed directly from the official document: approximately Gs. 2,783,457-2,905,929 total (residency plus radicacion certificate).
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the Constancia de Inversionista Extranjero through SUACE, commit USD 70,000 and 5 local jobs within 24 months, then file the Permanent Residency application at DNM with the required apostilled documents.

evidence_required.document: Criminal background checks (origin country, residence country, INTERPOL, Paraguayan police)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 6 months per year during the 3-year permanent-residency clock before naturalization eligibility (per tier-3 summary; not independently confirmed in the tier-1 requirements document)

sources.title: SUACE (Sistema Unificado de Apertura y Cierre de Empresas, Vice-Ministry of Industry and Commerce) -- official Constancia de Inversionista Extranjero requirements: USD 70,000 minimum investment, 5-job creation, 24-month completion window

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Paraguay). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- this is the strongest-sourced Paraguay route in this build: the hard requirement's core figures (USD 70,000, 5 jobs, 24-month window) were read directly from an official suace.gov.py PDF, not paraphrased from a tier-3 site. GENUINE, CONFIRMED STALE/WRONG-FIGURE CATCH, consistent with this dataset's recurring thesis: a widely-syndicated tier-3 summary (goparaguay.co, and mirrored on other tier-3/4 investor-migration sites found during this build) describes the USD 70,000 as payable 'spread over 10 years,' but the primary SUACE document states both the investment and the job-creation commitment must be completed within 24 months -- a materially different and stricter timeline. This dataset follows the tier-1 figure and flags the discrepancy rather than picking whichever number appeared more often. pr_after_months set to 0 since the SUACE track grants Permanent Residency directly (no separate temporary-residency period), unlike the general work-permit route. citizenship_after_months (36) and the 6-months-per-year presence requirement come only from the tier-3 source and were NOT independently confirmed in the tier-1 documents reached, which covered residency mechanics but not the onward citizenship timeline -- disclosed as a gap rather than presented as tier-1-confirmed.
